# Machine Learning in Quantitative Finance

## An Applied Study of Machine Learning Methods for Financial Data

**Ebube Anozie**  
PhD Student in Applied Mathematics  
University of Colorado Boulder

---

## About the Project

This project investigates the application of machine learning
methods to quantitative-finance problems. Throughout the
semester, different machine learning techniques will be
applied to financial data and evaluated from both computational
and quantitative perspectives.

## Research Question

> How effectively can machine learning methods identify useful
> patterns in financial market data?

## Methods

Throughout the project, I will investigate:

- Regression
- Clustering
- Dimensionality reduction
- Ensemble methods
- Other machine learning methods introduced in CSCI 5612

## Project Goals

The goal is to understand not only how these models perform,
but also how machine learning can be used as a tool for
quantitative financial analysis.

---

## About Me

I am a PhD student in Applied Mathematics at the University of
Colorado Boulder. My research interests include quantitative
finance, mathematical modeling, numerical methods, and
machine learning.
